PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
PrivacyPage.content:
At Young Leaders Academy, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our website or apply for our programs. We are committed to ensuring compliance with international and regional data protection laws, including the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) in the MENA region.

### 1. Information We Collect
We may collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, date of birth, educational background, and payment details when you register for a program, subscribe to our newsletter, or contact us.

### 2. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected data to:
- Process your program applications and enrollment.
- Provide customer support and respond to inquiries.
- Send you updates, newsletters, and promotional materials (you can opt-out at any time).
- Improve our website, services, and overall user experience.

### 3. Data Security
We implement robust security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

### 4. Your Rights
You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time. If you wish to exercise these rights, please contact our support team.

TermsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsPage.subtitle: Rules and guidelines for using our platform and programs.
TermsPage.content:
Welcome to Young Leaders Academy. By accessing our website or enrolling in our programs, you agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

### 1. Program Enrollment
Enrollment in our programs is subject to availability and meeting the specific admission requirements of each program. Young Leaders Academy reserves the right to accept or reject any application at its sole discretion.

### 2. Fees and Payments
All program fees must be paid in full prior to the start of the program unless a specific payment plan has been agreed upon. Fees are non-refundable except as expressly stated in our Refund Policy.

### 3. Code of Conduct
Students are expected to maintain the highest standards of behavior, respect, and academic integrity. Any form of harassment, discrimination, or academic dishonesty will result in immediate dismissal from the program without a refund.

### 4. Intellectual Property
All content, materials, and resources provided during the programs are the intellectual property of Young Leaders Academy and may not be reproduced, distributed, or shared without prior written consent.

### 5. Limitation of Liability
Young Leaders Academy shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising out of your participation in our programs or use of our website.

FaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our programs, admissions, and policies.
FaqPage.q1: Who can apply to the Young Leaders Academy?
FaqPage.a1: Our programs are open to ambitious students generally between the ages of 14 and 25, depending on the specific program. We welcome applicants from all around the world who demonstrate a passion for leadership and learning.
FaqPage.q2: Are the programs conducted in English or Arabic?
FaqPage.a2: We offer programs in both English and Arabic. The specific language of instruction is indicated on the program details page. Students must demonstrate proficiency in the language of their chosen program.
FaqPage.q3: Do you offer scholarships or financial aid?
FaqPage.a3: Yes, we offer a limited number of merit-based and need-based scholarships each year. You can indicate your interest in applying for financial aid during the application process.
FaqPage.a4: While we provide extensive preparation, mentorship, and direct exposure to our partner universities, admission to these institutions remains highly competitive and is ultimately decided by the university's admissions committee.
FaqPage.a5: Program fees are fully refundable up to 30 days before the program start date. Cancellations made within 30 days of the start date are subject to a cancellation fee. Please refer to our Terms & Conditions for full details.
